activation: When DATA_DIR contains paper.pdf and metadata.json, activate academic investigation.

paper_positioning.title: Paper Positioning
research: Novelty assessment: is this opening a new direction, advancing an existing line, or an incremental contribution?
Lineage: the 3-5 most important prior works this builds on, and what each contributed.
Competitor landscape: the main alternative approaches to the same problem, and how they compare.
Timeline: when the research area emerged and its major milestones.

extract_task_demo.title: Extract Task Demo Example
extract_task_demo.detail: When the paper describes a system, model, or pipeline, find ONE concrete example that shows what the system actually does. This powers the Designer's 'Task Demo' visualization. Look in: case studies (usually Section 4/5 or supplementary), running examples in methods, GitHub README examples, supplementary tables with full model outputs.
pick_example_that_is: the most surprising or impressive result
structured enough to fill three tabs (input, reasoning, output)

schema.title: Example title (e.g., protein name, sentence, image)
schema.subtitle: Brief context (e.g., organism, domain, source)
schema.reasoning: The intermediate reasoning/processing text (chain-of-thought, attention, steps)

venue_and_review_context.title: Venue & Review Context
if_reviews_json_exists: Venue profile: acceptance rate, reputation, typical paper profile.
Review culture: does the venue favor novelty, rigor, or impact? Constructive or adversarial?
Best paper criteria: what has won best paper here before? What patterns emerge?
Reviewer concern calibration: are the raised weaknesses common at this venue, or unusual?
Community reception: social media discussion, blog posts, follow-up work citing this paper.
if_reviews_not_available: Still research the venue and community reception.
Look for informal reviews (blog posts, Twitter/X threads, Reddit discussions).

impact_assessment.title: Impact Assessment
research: Citation velocity: how quickly is this being cited relative to its age?
Downstream adoption: has anyone built on this work? Open-source implementations? Industry adoption?
Media coverage: tech press, science journalism, policy discussions?
Reproducibility: are code/data available? Has anyone attempted reproduction?

fetch_review_and_audit_deep_dive.title: Fetch Review & Audit Deep-Dive Content
fetch_review_and_audit_deep_dive.when: The dataset is about a conference/venue with multiple papers (e.g. Agents4Science, CAFA, workshop proceedings) and review or audit data is accessible.
fetch_review_and_audit_deep_dive.detail: Fetch 2-4 representative paper reviews/audits for the Designer's 'Paper + Review Browser' mode. Pick papers that illustrate the blog's narrative: the best, the worst, the most controversial, the most ironic. For each, extract title, scores, verdict/decision, key findings (3-5 bullets), a notable auditor/reviewer quote, and the external link.
fetch_review_and_audit_deep_dive.sources: OpenReview API, venue audit pages, conference websites, Semantic Scholar. If reviews are behind authentication, note this in the JSON and skip.

output_additions._description: Add these items to detective.json with appropriate categories.
